name: microfrontend-architecture-assignment
description: React Microfrontend Architecture with Webpack 5 Module Federation

scripts.start: concurrently -n "PRODUCTS,CART,HOST" -c "magenta,green,blue" "npm --prefix products-app start" "npm --prefix cart-app start" "npm --prefix host-app start"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n "PRODUCTS,CART,HOST" -c "magenta,green,blue" "npm --prefix products-app start" "npm --prefix cart-app start" "npm --prefix host-app start"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix products-app run build && npm --prefix cart-app run build && npm --prefix host-app run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix products-app install && npm --prefix cart-app install && npm --prefix host-app install
